init.title: Blink Plus options
init.description: Polling and live view settings. Live view only runs while something is watching the stream (a dashboard, Apple Home, go2rtc...).

data.stream_host: Live view listen address (0.0.0.0 lets go2rtc/Frigate on other hosts connect)
data.stream_base_port: First live view TCP port (0 = random; set e.g. 18550 for fixed ports per camera)
data.stream_max_minutes: Max live view minutes per viewing (0 = unlimited, uses more battery)
data.stream_linger: Seconds to keep the session after the last viewer leaves
data.usb_motion_minutes: Check the USB clip list for motion every N minutes (0 = never; any other value can make the Blink app show 'system busy' while it runs)
data.archive_folder: Copy USB clips to this folder (empty = off). Use /media/... – e.g. a PC share added under Settings → System → Storage
data.archive_interval_minutes: Copy new clips every N minutes (0 = only with the button / action)
data.archive_lookback_hours: Only copy clips from the last N hours (0 = everything on the drive)

save_recent_clips.name: Save recent clips

filename.description: Filename to writable path (directory may need to be included in allowlist_external_dirs in config).

save_video.name: Save video

stop_live_view.description: Ends the Blink live view session for this camera now (saves battery).

archive_clips.name: Archive clips
archive_clips.description: Copies new clips from the Sync Module USB drive to the archive folder (set in Blink Plus options). Pauses if a live view starts.

hours.name: Look back
hours.description: Only clips recorded in the last N hours (0 = all clips on the drive).

max_clips.name: Max clips
max_clips.description: Stop after this many clips; the rest are copied next run.
